title: Heteroscedastic Neural Surrogate Modeling for Robust and Rapid Bayesian Inference in Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2608.19377v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian inference via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) provides effective parameter estimation, but its real-time application in complex physical systems is hindered by heavy computational bottlenecks and extreme sensitivity to statistical noise. We address this by proposing a neural-network-based probabilistic surrogate framework for rapid and robust MCMC inference. Using fusion plasma Thomson scattering diagnostics as a challenging, noise-dominated testbed, our approach employs a dual-head architecture to simultaneously estimate the expected physical emission spectrum and the channel-wise intrinsic measurement noise variance. translated_title: 异方差神经代理建模用于聚变等离子体诊断中的稳健快速贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 摘要：通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法进行的贝叶斯推断提供了有效的参数估计，但其在复杂物理系统中的实时应用受到沉重计算瓶颈和对统计噪声极度敏感的阻碍。我们通过提出一种基于神经网络的概率代理框架来解决这一问题，以实现快速且稳健的MCMC推断。以聚变等离子体汤姆森散射诊断作为具有挑战性且噪声主导的测试平台，我们的方法采用双头架构，同时估计预期的物理发射光谱和通道级固有测量噪声方差。通过优化高斯负对数似然（GNLL）目标，学习到的偶然不确定性动态地缓冲采样器免受病态散粒噪声的影响。评估表明，该代理框架相比精确物理前向模型实现了超过1500倍的加速，同时减少了计算负担。
tldr: 本文提出了一种双头神经网络代理框架，通过同时估计光谱和异方差噪声并优化高斯负对数似然，实现了聚变等离子体诊断中贝叶斯推断的超1500倍加速和稳健性提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual-head neural surrogate framework that simultaneously estimates spectra and heteroscedastic noise via Gaussian negative log-likelihood optimization, achieving over 1500x acceleration and enhanced robustness for Bayesian inference in fusion plasma diagnostics.
